groups.canonical_value: Prefers a hotel room with a balcony and asks for or prioritizes one when selecting, searching, or evaluating rooms.
groups.merge_rationale: Both instances express the same concrete behavior: prefer, prioritize, and verify a hotel room with a balcony, without specifying an alternative amenity.
